## Design Settings » Homepage » Search Box Design
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078954

## Search Box Design
These settings control the main search module, in the first fold, of the website's homepage. The search module selected here will determine what the visitor of the website is going to be able to search for, as soon as they visit the website.
To edit the Search Box Design navigate to:
Settings
Design Settings
Homepage Tab

## Visual Guide of the Search Box Design
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136504875/original/FxfX3k3JHinw2QUabPVp4ihinWDtRlex4w.png?1703885809 | alt: ]

## 1. Search Box Background
This setting controls the background color for the search module.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136504969/original/Ru1LGS7S870IIT7GrZDvE7IRYzWg9KQE_g.png?1703885994 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136505013/original/eNbkTOG9XOlAmFNqeG0FH47AVtenPxkYRw.png?1703886044 | alt: ]

## 2. Background Visibility
This setting controls the transparency of the background color for the search module, 0 being invisible and 10 being fully visible.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136505105/original/kcuy9tvMpAWbyACc4CEHPnhcX4UfcuBRZw.png?1703886158 | alt: ]

## 3. Search Box Font Color
This setting controls the color of the font in the search module.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136505155/original/RDFLrzNAJAJm5gA4thMlbouvdEy2pgrlVQ.png?1703886294 | alt: ]

## 4. "Search" Button Background
This setting controls the color of the button in the search module.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136505184/original/-GeAORUKqucjtJn1QztRs0nFS-jWtfQmPw.png?1703886381 | alt: ]
